name: Draw a Sword
summary: Kneeling side-on, the outside hand starts at the opposite hip, pulls up across the body with a bent elbow and extends on a high diagonal.
steps: Kneel side-on, sitting on the heels; the arm furthest from the straps reaches across to hold a short loop.
Breathe in to draw the elbow up and across on a diagonal above the shoulder.
Breathe out to straighten the arm along that line.
Breathe in to bend; breathe out to return the hand across the body.

layers.title: With rotation
layers.text: Let the chest follow the hand.

modifications: Sit on the long box for sore knees.
cues:
Shoulders and hips stay square.
No twisting to help — unless you choose the rotation layer.
Long neck, relaxed shoulders.
Carriage moves smoothly, no jerks.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
